requirements.requirement: Read-only one-way Python projection of the AST, World 12 only; no Python parsed or executed
requirements.verification: Renderer test over the shared AST; no second parser in the dependency graph

requirements.requirement: One application entry point assembling every module, with a platform project per target
requirements.verification: The app builds and launches on each target in the device matrix

requirements.requirement: Navigation from profile to world map to tutorial and item player and Studio, with a back path from every screen
requirements.verification: Navigation test: every screen reachable, every screen exitable, no dead end

requirements.requirement: Application state survives process death; the child returns to the item they were on
requirements.verification: Force-kill test on the reference device, 50 times, as FR-M9-03 does for the Studio

requirements.requirement: One settings surface for interface language, keyword language and accessibility preferences, applied app-wide
requirements.verification: Setting each preference once changes every screen; asserted across the widget tree

requirements.requirement: Cold start goes to where the child was, with no login wall and no network call
requirements.verification: Cold start measured on the reference device with aircraft mode on

requirements.requirement: The shell composes modules and owns no learning logic: no grading, no mastery, no content
requirements.verification: Dependency test: the shell imports module APIs and defines no grader, no mastery rule and no item

requirements.requirement: Every world is a place with its own illustration; a world drawn as a numbered row is not shipped
requirements.verification: All thirteen worlds have a distinct drawing and a distinct spoken description; asserted in kodo_art

requirements.requirement: Art is geometry as data with two projections — the app's painter and the SVG emitter — and never a second drawing
requirements.verification: Both projections are generated from the same Drawing; the published SVG carries the same description the app speaks

requirements.requirement: Every illustration on screen carries the sentence a screen reader speaks, in both interface languages
requirements.verification: Widget test walks every Art on every screen and finds its description in the semantics tree

requirements.requirement: Colour is a role, not a hex: high contrast re-resolves the roles and never swaps the palette
requirements.verification: Every Tint resolves in both themes; no foreground ratio falls when high contrast is on

requirements.requirement: Every animation declares a reason (causality, continuity or feedback) and a reduced form; none exceeds the motion ceiling
requirements.verification: Motion table asserted in kodo_art: a reason, a reduced form that is not nothing, and 320 ms

requirements.requirement: Tika appears where a child is spoken to and never where a child is judged: no pose reacts to a verdict
requirements.verification: The stage pose has no face; the portrait and thinking poses do; no screen binds a pose to a grading outcome

requirements.requirement: A program is a set of scripts: `quand` with a flag, key or click trigger, at top level only
requirements.verification: Each trigger fires only its own scripts; a nested `quand` is refused in a child-language sentence

requirements.requirement: Scripts interleave one statement at a time, share variables, and a stepped run draws what a full-speed run draws
requirements.verification: Two scripts produce interleaved output, share one variable, and the stepped path signature equals the full-speed one

requirements.requirement: Sensing (key, mouse, edge, colour) answers from the item's scripted inputs, never from a live device
requirements.verification: The same program run twice gives the same answers; a canvas without sensing refuses in a sentence

requirements.requirement: A stage is an optional capability over Surface: costumes, backdrops, effects, speech and a recorded score
requirements.verification: Every existing Surface implementer still runs unchanged; a stage block on a plain canvas is refused in a sentence

requirements.requirement: Events, sensing and stage blocks are one AST with two projections, like every other block
requirements.verification: An event script round-trips through the renderer and reads identically in FR and EN

requirements.requirement: Every concept in the ledger names blocks the language has; a concept the language cannot express fails the build
requirements.verification: tools/trace_check.dart compares the concept ledger against the opcode table and fails on a gap
